# CASB Agency

CASB Agency Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian financial advisory agency established in 2006, serving clients through Kuala Lumpur, Ipoh and Sibu branches.

- Home: https://oikosadvisory.github.io/CASB/

- Insights: https://oikosadvisory.github.io/CASB/insights/index.html
- Events: https://oikosadvisory.github.io/CASB/events/index.html
- Achievements: https://oikosadvisory.github.io/CASB/#achievements
- Monthly Achievers: https://oikosadvisory.github.io/CASB/monthly-achievers/monthly.html
- Select Your Mentor: https://oikosadvisory.github.io/CASB/select-your-mentor/index.html

## Topics

- Financial advisory in Malaysia
- Insurance protection planning
- Medical card and critical illness education
- Wealth planning and advisor mentorship
- CASB awards, events and monthly achiever recognition
